MEC.name: Major Episodes of Contention (Chenoweth & Kang)
MEC.role: C1 primary truth (episode onset, duration, size, goals, outcomes)
MEC.coverage: 1955-2018, 2,734 episodes, >1 week and >=1,000 participants, English-language sources

ACLED.name: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data
ACLED.role: C2 primary truth (atomic day/location events: protests, riots, violence); I1 shock truth (with UCDP)
ACLED.access: free registration; API / export tool; weekly updates; attribution required; redistribution restricted by Terms of Use (commercial use requires licence review)
ACLED.event_definition: events recorded only for days on which activity is specifically reported; multi-day continuation is NOT inferred
ACLED.coverage_note: start year varies by region (Africa 1997; most of Asia/LatAm/Europe 2018+; global by 2021) — inclusion window per country fixed in §5
ACLED.version: snapshot date + sha256 recorded at ingestion (weekly release; pin one export)

MM.name: Mass Mobilization Protest Data (Clark & Regan, PITF)
MM.role: C2 secondary historical replication (1990-2020 government-directed protests >=50 participants)

UCDP_GED.name: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset
UCDP_GED.role: I1 independent shock truth (organized violence, day-level, adm1, fatalities)

WVS_EVS.name: EVS/WVS Integrated Values Surveys trend file
WVS_EVS.role: I1 human-state truth (national pride, security, confidence/trust)
WVS_EVS.version: IVS trend 4.1 (2024-06-30); WVS Wave 7 2017-2022 (64 societies, >80k respondents)
WVS_EVS.access: registration + acceptance of terms; academic/non-commercial; no redistribution

ESS.name: European Social Survey
ESS.role: I1 human-state truth, European subset with NUTS region (trust, attachment to country, safety)
ESS.access: registration; ESS data licence (non-commercial terms to be confirmed at registration)

splits.method: country-level deterministic hash split (balance across UN region x income group is REPORTED, not enforced); assignment = sha256('CASCADE_PUBLIC_v1|' + ISO2) mod 10 < 6 -> DEV else HOLDOUT (realized: 111 DEV / 83 HOLDOUT countries, holdout list sha256 d25828e7418cd619d90092804cd74b63416bbd645de4ecf4f66408eea90ebb1f); temporal holdout additionally: MEC onsets 2010-2018 and ACLED/UCDP events 2022+ are HOLDOUT-ONLY regardless of country
splits.holdout_freeze: the HOLDOUT ISO2 list is generated deterministically from the rule above and its sha256 recorded in benchmarks/cascade_public/holdout_v1.sha256 BEFORE any data is loaded; loaders refuse HOLDOUT rows unless EARTH1_HOLDOUT_RUN=<founder token>
